data.desc: TORM is one of the world's leading carriers of refined oil products. TORM operates a fleet of product tanker vessels with a strong commitment to safety. environmental responsibility and customer service. TORM was founded in 1889 and conducts business worldwide. TORM's shares are listed on Nasdaq in Copenhagen and on Nasdaq in New York (NASDAQ: TRMD A) (NASDAQ: TRMD) (ISIN: GB00BZ3CNK81).
